branches.label: trunk (main)
branches.description: The daily integration line. Development stays on trunk; a release branch is cut only when a version needs hardening.

branches.label: release/*
branches.description: Cut from main when a release is stabilization-bound. Only bug fixes and cherry-picks land here; fixes are promoted back to main.

branches.label: hotfix/*
branches.description: Branches from a release or main for a production incident, merged back into both.
